answer: Because the derivation is bound to the spiral signature, the nebula gate rejects a mismatch, and the ivory checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 82 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers hence has nothing to key against, and filling 218 aliases means authoring 218 texts that each match their own nonce. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
